incidence_rate_basis.note_en: Incidence Rate is computed from WPP population data during site generation; when population is unavailable, original database incidence is shown.
incidence_rate_basis.note_zh: 发病率在网页数据生成阶段按 WPP 人口重算（每10万人）；若缺少人口数据则回退显示数据库原始发病率。

brief_en: New Zealand page consolidates infectious disease surveillance records from phf_monthly. It combines source metadata, time-series charts, and downloadable machine-readable datasets.
brief_zh: 新西兰页面整合来自新西兰 PHF Science 法定传染病 的传染病监测记录，包含来源信息、时间序列图表和可下载数据。
surveillance_system_en: The dataset is built from configured official feeds for New Zealand; current primary sources include phf_monthly.
surveillance_system_zh: 该数据集来自新西兰已配置的官方数据源；当前主要来源包括新西兰 PHF Science 法定传染病。
interpretation_en: Coverage currently spans 2016-01-01 to 2026-05-01 across 33 tracked diseases.
reporting_cadence_en: Source reporting frequency is inferred as MONTHLY; charts use weekly-equivalent normalization where applicable.
reporting_cadence_zh: 来源报告频率推断为 MONTHLY；相关图表在适用时使用周等价归一化。
limitations_en: Counts reflect reported surveillance records and may be affected by case definitions, reporting lag, source cadence, and missing population denominators.
limitations_zh: 病例数反映已报告的监测记录，可能受病例定义、报告延迟、来源频率和人口分母缺失影响。
source_summary_zh: 新西兰 PHF Science 法定传染病
